mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_musical WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS likeMusicalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_review WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS likeReviewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM like_actor WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS likeActorCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS reviewCount;
SELECT m.* FROM review r JOIN musical m ON r.musical_id = m.musical_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_date DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT a.*, count(*) as count FROM users as u join review as r ON u.user_id = r.user_id join musical as m on m.musical_id = r.musical_id join cast as c on c.musical_id = m.musical_id join actor as a on c.actor_id = a.actor_id where u.user_id = #{userId} group by a.actor_id order by count(*) desc;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password, name, email, phone, nickname) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{nickname})
mapper.select: SELECT @@hostname AS host, @@port AS port, @@datadir AS datadir
